why: MongoClient, db.collection() and getDb() belong to the gateway. A raw collection here bypasses session scoping, id rehydration and the one place that knows the collections; use the gateway's exported functions or its typed scope.
bad:
const rows = await getDb().collection('sessions').find({}).toArray();
const r = await sessionsCollection().findOne({ id });
good:
const rows = await listSessions(ownerId);
await scope.experiments.insertOne(doc);
